India eyes domestic reactors for 100 GW nuclear power expansion

India is planning to utilize locally designed nuclear reactors to accelerate its goal of achieving 100 GW of nuclear power capacity. This strategy aims to expedite regulatory approvals and leverage an established domestic supply chain. The move is part of a broader global revival in nuclear power, with companies focusing on domestic designs to avoid potential delays associated with foreign-sourced reactors. Two niche engineering stocks are identified as potential beneficiaries of this expansion.
